name: King EX70
description: King EX70 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX70C comp / gate (1987). Compressor: INPUT -6 to -42 dB, RATIO 2:1 to 20:1, ATTACK 0.2 to 40 ms, RELEASE 0.04 to 1.5 s, up to 32 dB of compression, OUTPUT. Gate: THRESHOLD (OFF to MAX) and DECAY 5 ms to 1.5 s. COMP REDUCTION and GATE REDUCTION lights, EFFECT in/out.
author: The Disk King
